__comment: Sample parameter bindings for the catalogue-commons demo runs (2026-10-22). Declared slots default to the catalogue entry's example values; the slots below are EITHER explicit overrides of declared slots whose example is a list/not directly usable, OR probe-referenced slots that are not in the entries' declared parameter lists (known core-catalogue data gap — see docs/CATALOGUE_COMMONS.md). List values are spliced into argv as multiple tokens. Every value here is synthetic and recorded verbatim in each demo run's bindings.json + composition.json. Nothing is executed: probes only ask the harness for its ruling.
